What is the creepiest thing that has ever happened to you?

I was walking home from a friends house when I was a teen and the same yellow VW bug passed me going the same way 3 or 4 times. I can't remember whether I ran home or not, but I was definitely freaked out.

When my SO's uncle died... wait let me back up. My SO's uncle was a real scumbag and a heroin addict. As a result he was always calling his mother.. a 70 year old and belittling her in an attempt to get money. 10-20 phone calls a day all to the answering machine of him yelling and cursing and guilt tripping and dragging her name through the mud. Well after years of this, he died of drug related reasons. That night, her phone blew up with phone calls from 000-000-0000. No one was ever on the line. It never happened before or since. Only the night he died. I'm a skeptic of all things but I do think he was trying to call. Angry that he died, demanding that she fix it somehow and refusing to move on.
That's pretty scary. In order to ruin the fun I will tell you that telemarketers call with numbers like that to get you to try to pick up.

No I know. But it's weird that no answered. It's even more weird that I couldn't' find it on my vonage call log. And the weirdest part was it happened hours after he died and never happened like that again.

Not very creepy, but one time me and my siblings were playing in our front yard, which isn't very big. Our mom was watching us and a car slowed down and stopped in front of our house. My mom stood up to see the license plate and then the car sped off. We went inside and the car went up and down our street a few times before leaving.

Another story, which didn't happen to me, but our neighbour. During hurricane Sandy, a car slowed down and a guy got out while he was walking up the street. Needless to say, he ran inside his house, which was a couple of yards away.

I once had a guy in a big white pedo-van ask me if I wanted to buy some meth when I was in the 2nd grade late at night. I rarely stayed outside late after this event for another 3 years worried about meth peddlers.

I have always had trouble with sleep paralysis since I was a little kid, once I knew what it was, it stopped being scary and more of an annoyance. So about three years ago, I start to experience it more frequently than usual and my gf had just moved in with me. One night, it was really bad, I remember just freezing up and there being a big flash of light and then the usual hallucination of seeing dark figures standing in the room, for some reason, I freaked out more than usual and started trying to scream for help. Eventually I woke up more and started screaming out loud and I finally snap out of it. My gf says "What the fuck was that?" I tried explaining my sleep paralysis to her and she says "No, not the screaming, those people in the room that showed up after that flash of light. as soon as you started screaming, they were gone."

nothing like that has happened since then, and she refuses to talk about it to this day but seriously guys, what the fuck.

I was working as a light board tech for my high school play festival. I was but a lowly freshman, and it was my first show in the booth. In with me was the stage manager Gary, and the sound guy Alex. It would both ignite my love for theatre, and making me superstitious.

The show was going really smoothly until about halfway through the first act. One of our spotlighters (who are up in a catwalk over the audience) reported hearing footsteps on the walkway, like someone was up with them. We figured they had just left the door to the ladder open and some actor had wandered up. We told them that they had time before their next cue, so they should go and herd whoever was up there before locking the door. They go off comms.

A considerable amount of time passes and we haven't heard anything. 10 minutes is a long time in the theatre business, and at this point the possibility of a serial killer on the catwalk was not ruled out. We were really worried, so we called our theatre teacher over. We told him what was going on, and he decided to go up there to check on them.

Another 10 minutes passes. Our teacher has not returned. The spotlight operators have not returned. We send Alex.

10 more minutes pass.

At this point Gary and I are freaking the fuck out. We are certain that a serial killer is in the building, and has just killed our coworkers. I was about ready to go up myself before it started:

The most bone chilling, metal on metal clanging started up, and it was coming from the catwalk. It was slow, rhythmic, and very loud. Clank. Pause. Clank. Pause. Clank. The audience looked around wandering what was going on, the actors hesitated for a second, everyone in the booth jumped out of their chairs.

And then it stopped.

Alex and our teacher returned. The spotlighters came back on comms. And everything was fine. Except none of them heard the noise or recalled any time passing.
So they don't even remember it happening? wow!

So me and my mate were driving home along the highway, and after 10 minutes we hadn't seen some of the landmarks we should have, so we got off at the next exit to turn around. When we got to where the highway underpass was meant to be, it was no longer there and there was an roundabout intersection with shops that wasn't there before and a way back onto the highway. Right where we came through. We got on the highway and left at the speed limit. Being a little bit freaked out we both had a cigarette, I asked for the lighter, we only had one but it was scratched in a really unique way, the way worn lighters often get with hard use. There was two in the console when my mate reached for it, with the exact same markings. Shit was scary.

tl;dr Got stuck driving in alt universe for 20 minutes, got a free lighter out of it.
